purpose: Check whether the current repository AC1024 sample set reproduces the reported R2010 CLASSES high-bit-size failure.
source_tree: current worktree, including existing user modification to src/drw_objects.cpp
operation: For every tests/samples/AC1024/*.dwg and every AC1024 DWG under /Users/dli/doc/dwg, run dwg2dxf <input> -y -d -v2010 <temporary-output>; inspect final operationSucceeded/legacyError fields and CLASSES CRC diagnostics. The wrapper END marker alone is not treated as proof of parser success.

summary.interpretation: The alleged CLASSES failure is not reproduced by the current repository corpus. Most command failures occur later during strict output qualification or read-completeness checks; they are not CLASSES failures. The additional AGENTS.md-referenced /Users/dli/doc/dwg tree contains nine AC1024 DWGs, and all nine also report operationSucceeded=true and legacyError=0 with no CLASSES CRC mismatch. The stated six-of-ten result therefore remains unverified for the current available source set; the referenced tree contains nine AC1024 paths, not ten.

onlineSampleSearch.result: Found public AC1024 candidates, but no online sample with verifiable AutoCAD 2010 RTM provenance or a known matching CLASSES failure. Existing corpus recheck remains the only reproduced evidence; the missing tenth source and reported RTM failure remain unresolved. External files were not added to the repository.

generatedIntegrationControl.profile: A from-scratch AC1024 DWG contains a class 600 definition with 2048-character app, C++ class and DXF record names. Its combined UTF-16 string stream exceeds the 0x7fff-bit short footer limit; the extended high-size word is decoded and the complete strings are recovered through readDwgClasses().
generatedIntegrationControl.fixture: Generated entirely in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture file added.

disposition: The generated high-bit footer path now has full AC1024 writer-to-reader regression coverage. No parser change was indicated by the available nine AC1024 source files. Keep the reported six-of-ten failure unresolved pending the missing tenth sample or exact failing sample hashes and a reproducible BAD_READ_CLASSES result. Do not commit any sample files.
